context: Request: the underwriting breakdown (firm-commitment, best-efforts, other) of every Capital Markets matter, including shelved, withdrawn and never-executed ones. Rubric: classify 22 matters (20 as firm commitment, 1036-00002 as best efforts, 1013-00002 as other/non-underwritten) plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read on the store folder, which fails because it is a directory.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements, memos, engagement letters and emails from the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide text-extraction script for structure terms; times out with partial output.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Counts files per matter folder across the store.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find piped to grep over file paths for offering-document words, cut at 200 lines by its own head limit.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Script prints the text of every engagement letter in the store (about 476K characters).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements, offering memoranda, engagement letters and memos from twelve candidates.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a breakdown of seventeen matters: twelve firm-commitment, one agency program, the rest other.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Scans surfaced most qualifying matters, but it classified only the twelve it opened plus a few others, misplaced one, and added non-qualifying matters.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: After a timed-out store-wide scan and a capped file-name list, it relied on a scan limited to engagement letters, which never reached one qualifying matter, and ran no other search.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The engagement-letter scan showed about twenty qualifying matters, but it opened only twelve candidates and its breakdown omits most of the others.
Read one matter's draft program prospectus supplement and placed it in an agency bucket instead of best efforts (evidence seen at [34]-[40]).
Counted several non-qualifying matters in the breakdown.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches of reads of agreements, memos, engagement letters and emails from the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a breakdown of the three listing-top matters: one firm commitment, none best efforts, two other.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Never searched; classified only the three matters at the top of a capped listing.

first_error.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
first_error.why: Never searched; built the whole-book breakdown from the three matters at the top of a capped listing.

other_errors.why: Asserted the three listing-top matters, all outside the permitted set, in the breakdown.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: A depth-limited find returns nothing, then a whole-store glob and a glob of the matters folder that matches nothing.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads agreements, memos, engagement letters and an email from the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide script lists every document mentioning structure terms (about 332K characters).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Script groups file paths with offering-document words by matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of underwriting, purchase and note purchase agreements from twelve candidates.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Script pulls status and structure sentences from key documents of a named list of 25 candidate matters.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists the files of one candidate.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads one more purchase agreement.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes a matter-by-matter breakdown of about 26 matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits counts and entries, re-reads parts of the response and greps it for stale counts; a shell grep cannot find the file.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Classified twenty matters as expected but omitted one scan hit, misplaced one program matter, and added non-qualifying matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The store-wide scan listed the one non-underwritten placement matter, but it built its candidate list from the file-name search, which did not include it, and never opened or classified it.

other_errors.why: Classified the one program matter from extracted sentences as agency/other instead of best efforts (evidence seen at [34]-[35]).
Included several non-qualifying matters in the breakdown.

divergence: All three failed. T1 never searched and classified only the listing-top matters (partial-listing-as-corpus at the reading stage). T0 and T2 scanned the store and classified many matters, but each lost matters at selection: T0 relied on an engagement-letter-only scan that missed one matter (search-miss) and then opened only twelve of the matters it showed; T2 dropped one scan hit when it switched to a file-name candidate list (surfaced-not-opened). Both placed the program matter outside best efforts, and all three included non-qualifying matters.
